subject: 龙兴观道德经幢 · 幢身与莲座局部
author: 爱浮屠
source_note: 采用爱浮屠2017年2月2日实拍（2019年文章发布），仅绘可见幢身与莲座。经文纹理为意写，不可用作字迹释读；现代亭与被遮挡的幢顶未画。
prompt: Draw a carefully faithful fine-line DETAIL study of the inscribed stone SHAFT AND LOTUS BASE of the Tang Daodejing pillar at Longxing Guan, Yi County, using photograph2 as geometry. First Longmen image is STYLE ONLY. This is intentionally a partial object study: draw the tall octagonal stone column with clearly angled adjacent faces, the horizontal joint about one-quarter below its upper visible edge, its vertical inscription columns and weathered actual scars, down to the large rounded lotus-petal base and short carved support below it. The upper ancient stone cap is hidden behind the modern shelter, so DO NOT invent a cap, tiled roof, finial or topmost lotus. Let the upper shaft contour finish gently in a few broken strokes before white margin to signify unshown portion. Remove entirely the modern protective pavilion, all red columns/beams, metal fence, sign, background trees, and watermark. Do not attempt legible new Chinese texts; use very sparse broken short strokes in narrow vertical inscription rows, visible weathering only as selected outlines, never dense mottled texture. Stone column stays white, thin black contour, no shading, grey/sepia fill or hatching. The drawing should evoke the ancient incised object with quiet airy precision like the master, portrait1024x1536, generous side margins, lotus base comfortably above canvas bottom.

site_recommendation.name: 龙兴观道德经幢
site_recommendation.lede: 八棱石柱上，经文随石面一行行展开，残裂穿过字迹与莲瓣。龙兴观虽已不存，这座唐代经幢仍把道教经典留在原来的县城中。
facts: 经幢立于唐开元二十六年（738），刻《道德经》与唐玄宗注。
八棱幢身下承莲座；书者传为苏灵芝，条目保留传称而不作确定署名。
参考照片中上部被保护亭梁遮挡，本图只取可见幢身与莲座，不补绘幢顶或现代亭子。
